title: 有源低通：会“忘掉高音”的放大器
summary: 反相放大器的反馈电阻旁边并一个电容：测通带增益、扫频找截止频率，最后故意加大输入，看单电源 op-amp（运算放大器）把顶部削平。
description: LM358 反相放大器（RIN 4.7 kΩ、RF 10 kΩ，IN+ 偏置在 4.5 V，输入经 10 µF 隔直），RF 上并联 CF（15 nF）。H(jω) = −(RF/RIN)/(1 + jωRF·CF)。

cards.title: 扫一遍，加个电容，再扫一遍
text: 板上已经搭好一个**反相放大器**：增益由 **RF**（`10 kΩ`）和 **RIN**（`4.7 kΩ`）决定，IN+ 接在 4.5 V 的分压点上。CH1 看输入，CH2 看 OUT。
信号发生器：**正弦波、幅度 `1 V`**。频率从 **`100 Hz`** 调到 **`10 kHz`**：CH2 的大小几乎不变。
现在把**电容**（`15 nF`）插在 **`d11`**–**`d10`**，和 RF 并联。再扫一遍：频率高的时候，CH2 怎么样了？

cards.title: 反馈电阻旁边多了一条快车道
text: - 反相放大器的增益是 $R_F / R_{IN}$（输出和输入反相）。反馈支路越“难走”，增益越大。
- CF 并在 RF 旁边。低频时电容几乎断开，反馈还是 RF，增益不变；频率越高，CF 越像导线，反馈支路越“好走”，增益就往下掉。
![](fig:circuit)
- 增益掉到通带 0.707 倍的那个频率，就是截止频率：
- 它只由 RF 和 CF 决定，和信号源的内阻无关。这就是**有源滤波器**：op-amp（运算放大器）负责放大和推动负载，RC 负责挑频率。
![](fig:gain)

cards.title: 测增益，再故意削顶
text: - **`106 Hz`**：读幅度比（CH2 的 Vpp ÷ CH1 的 Vpp）。
- **扫频**：找 CH2 相对 CH1 的相位差变成 **+135°** 的频率——反相的 180° 再落后 45°。
- **`10.6 kHz`**：再读一次幅度比。
- 回到 **`106 Hz`**，把幅度加到 **`2 V`**。看 CH2 的顶和底：用格子读出最高点和最低点。

cards.title: 带走
text: - **有源低通 = 反相放大 × RC 低通**：通带增益 $R_F / R_{IN}$，截止频率 $\frac{1}{2π R_F C_F}$。输出由 op-amp（运算放大器）推动，接上负载滤波特性也不变。
- 单电源 9 V 的 LM358，输出只能在 0～7.5 V 之间。中心在 4.5 V，往上只剩 3 V——输入一大，顶部先被削平。
- 坑：10 µF 的 CIN 一般是**电解电容**。+ 脚朝直流电位高的一侧：这里是 RIN 一侧（4.5 V），信号发生器一侧是 0 V。仿真里的电容不分正负，接反也不会报错。

caption.text: RF 和 CF 并联在 IN− 和 VOUT 之间（op-amp（运算放大器）没画出来）。频率越高，CF 越像导线，增益越小。

i18n.en: RF and CF in parallel between IN− and VOUT (the op-amp is not drawn). The higher the frequency, the more CF looks like a wire and the lower the gain.

caption.text: 加了 CF 以后：低频增益不变，过了 f_c 越来越小。没有 CF 时是一条平线（虚线）。

i18n.en: With CF: the low-frequency gain stays, and past f_c it falls. Without CF it is a flat line (dashed).

en.title: Active low-pass: an amplifier that forgets the high notes
en.summary: A capacitor across the feedback resistor of an inverting amplifier: measure the passband gain, sweep for the cutoff frequency, then overdrive it and watch the single-supply op-amp flatten the top.
en.description: An LM358 inverting amplifier (RIN 4.7 kΩ, RF 10 kΩ, IN+ biased at 4.5 V, input through a 10 µF coupling capacitor) with CF (15 nF) across RF. H(jω) = −(RF/RIN)/(1 + jωRF·CF).
compare: It's an inverting amplifier with gain −RF/RIN = −10/4.7 ≈ −2.13 times an RC low-pass with fc = 1/(2π × 10 kΩ × 15 nF) ≈ 1061 Hz.
- **106 Hz**: |H| ≈ 2.12, phase ≈ 180° − 5.7° ≈ +176° (inverted; CIN adds about 2° of lead). Output ≈ 4.2 Vpp centred on 4.5 V.

**Think about it**: compared with the passive RC low-pass (Experiment 4-1): the passband gain can exceed 1; the op-amp drives the output, so a load doesn't change the response; and fc depends only on RF·CF, not on the source resistance.

**The single-supply limit**: the LM358 output can only move between 0 and 7.5 V (V+ − 1.5 V). Centred at 4.5 V there are 3 V of room upwards and 4.5 V downwards, so in the passband the input amplitude can be at most about 3 V / 2.13 ≈ 1.4 V; beyond that the output peak would exceed 7.5 V and the top of the wave gets flattened (distortion). For a larger undistorted swing, bias at 3.75 V (midway between 0 and 7.5 V) or use a split supply.

**Clipping experiment**: turn the amplitude up to 2 V (106 Hz). The ideal output peak would be 4.5 + 2 × 2.12 ≈ 8.7 V, above 7.5 V, so the top of the wave is flattened at 7.5 V; the bottom, 4.5 − 4.2 ≈ 0.3 V, is still above 0 V and is not clipped (the flattened top changes CIN's average current, so the centre shifts slightly and the bottom lands around 0.3–0.5 V). The last test checks exactly this.

measurements.ask: 106 Hz: amplitude ratio OUT/VIN (CH2 Vpp ÷ CH1 Vpp, the passband gain)
measurements.explain: In the passband CF is practically open: |H| ≈ RF/RIN = 10/4.7 ≈ 2.13 (× 0.995 ≈ 2.12 at 106 Hz).

measurements.ask: Sweep: the frequency where OUT's phase relative to VIN falls to +135° (= 180° − 45°), i.e. the cutoff fc
measurements.explain: H = −(RF/RIN)/(1 + jωRF·CF), fc = 1/(2π × 10 kΩ × 15 nF) ≈ 1061 Hz, set by RF·CF alone and independent of the source resistance.

measurements.ask: 106 Hz, amplitude 2 V: OUT's highest point, read off the grid
measurements.explain: The ideal peak 4.5 + 2 × 2.12 ≈ 8.7 V is above V+ − 1.5 V = 7.5 V, so the top is flattened at ≈ 7.5 V.

measurements.ask: Same state: OUT's lowest point, read off the grid
measurements.explain: The ideal lowest point is 4.5 − 2 × 2.12 ≈ 0.26 V; with the top clipped off, CIN's average current changes and the centre moves up a little, so the bottom sits near 0.47 V — still above 0 V, not clipped. With a 4.5 V centre there are only 3 V of headroom upwards, so the largest passband input is about 3 / 2.13 ≈ 1.4 V.

hints: Power the op-amp first: pin 8 to +9 V, pin 4 to GND.
RF and CF are in parallel, both between IN− and OUT.
IN+ goes to the middle of the RB1/RB2 divider (4.5 V), not to GND.
tests: 106 Hz: sensible passband gain, inverted, centred on VREF
1061 Hz (fc): the gain drops to 0.707 of the passband
106 Hz, amplitude 2 V: the top is flattened, the bottom is not

cards.title: Sweep, add a capacitor, sweep again
text: An **inverting amplifier** is already built: **RF** (`10 kΩ`) and **RIN** (`4.7 kΩ`) set its gain, and IN+ sits on a 4.5 V divider. CH1 shows the input, CH2 the output OUT.
Generator: **sine, amplitude `1 V`**. Turn the frequency from **`100 Hz`** up to **`10 kHz`**: CH2 hardly changes size.
Now plug a **capacitor** (`15 nF`) into **`d11`**–**`d10`**, in parallel with RF. Sweep again: what happens to CH2 at high frequencies?

cards.title: A fast lane next to the feedback resistor
text: - An inverting amplifier's gain is $R_F / R_{IN}$ (the output is inverted). The "harder" the feedback path, the bigger the gain.

- CF sits beside RF. At low frequency the capacitor is almost open, the feedback is still RF and the gain stays put; the higher the frequency, the more CF looks like a wire, the "easier" the feedback path and the lower the gain.
![](fig:circuit)
- The frequency where the gain has fallen to 0.707 of the passband is the cutoff frequency:
- Only RF and CF set it, not the source's resistance. This is an **active filter**: the op-amp amplifies and drives the load, the RC picks the frequencies.
![](fig:gain)

cards.title: Measure the gain, then clip it on purpose
text: - **`106 Hz`**: read the amplitude ratio (CH2 Vpp ÷ CH1 Vpp).
- **Sweep**: find the frequency where the phase of CH2 vs CH1 becomes **+135°** — the 180° of the inversion, minus a 45° lag.
- **`10.6 kHz`**: read the amplitude ratio again.
- Back to **`106 Hz`**, raise the amplitude to **`2 V`**. Look at the top and bottom of CH2: read the highest and lowest points off the grid.

cards.title: Take away
text: - **Active low-pass = inverting amplifier × RC low-pass**: passband gain $R_F / R_{IN}$, cutoff $\frac{1}{2π R_F C_F}$. The op-amp drives the output, so a load does not change the filter.
- On a single 9 V supply the LM358's output can only move between 0 and 7.5 V. Centred at 4.5 V it has just 3 V of room upwards — drive it too hard and the top is flattened first.

- Pitfall: a 10 µF CIN is usually an **electrolytic**. Its + lead faces the higher DC voltage: here the RIN side (4.5 V); the generator side is at 0 V. The simulated capacitor has no polarity, so a reversed one raises no warning.

tests.name: 106 Hz：通带增益合理，反相，中心在 VREF
106 Hz，幅度 2 V：顶部被削平，底部没有

compare: 它就是一个增益为 −RF/RIN = −10/4.7 ≈ −2.13 的反相放大器，再乘上一个 RC 低通，fc = 1/(2π × 10 kΩ × 15 nF) ≈ 1061 Hz。
**想一想**：和无源 RC 低通（实验 4-1）比：通带增益可以大于 1；输出由 op-amp（运算放大器）驱动，接上负载也不会改变滤波特性；截止频率只由 RF·CF 决定，和信号源内阻无关。
**单电源的限制**：LM358 输出只能在 0 ~ 7.5 V（V+ − 1.5 V）之间。中心 4.5 V 时，往上只有 3 V 的空间，往下 4.5 V。所以在通带里输入幅度最大约 3 V / 2.13 ≈ 1.4 V；再大，输出峰值超过 7.5 V，波形的顶部就会被削平（失真）。想要更大的不失真摆幅，可以把偏置点调到 3.75 V（0 和 7.5 V 的中点），或者用双电源。
**削顶实验**：把幅度调到 2 V（106 Hz）。理想输出峰值应是 4.5 + 2 × 2.12 ≈ 8.7 V，超过了 7.5 V，所以波形顶部被削平在 7.5 V；底部 4.5 − 4.2 ≈ 0.3 V 还在 0 V 以上，没有被削（被削的顶部让 CIN 的平均电流变化，中心会略微移动，所以底部大约在 0.3–0.5 V）。最后一个测试检查的就是这一点。

measurements.ask: 106 Hz：幅度比 OUT/VIN（CH2 的 Vpp ÷ CH1 的 Vpp，通带增益）
扫频：OUT 相对 VIN 的相位降到 +135°（= 180° − 45°）的频率，也就是截止频率 fc
measurements.explain: H = −(RF/RIN)/(1 + jωRF·CF)，fc = 1/(2π × 10 kΩ × 15 nF) ≈ 1061 Hz，只由 RF·CF 决定，和信号源内阻无关。

measurements.ask: 106 Hz、幅度 2 V：用格子读 OUT 的最高点
同一状态：用格子读 OUT 的最低点
measurements.explain: 理想的最低点是 4.5 − 2 × 2.12 ≈ 0.26 V；顶部被削掉后，CIN 的平均电流变了，中心略微上移，最低点约 0.47 V——仍在 0 V 以上，没有被削。中心 4.5 V 时往上只有 3 V 的空间，所以通带里输入幅度最大约 3 / 2.13 ≈ 1.4 V。

hints: 先给 op-amp（运算放大器）供电：8 脚接 +9 V，4 脚接 GND。
RF 和 CF 并联，都接在 IN− 和 OUT 之间。
IN+ 接 RB1/RB2 分压的中点（4.5 V），不是接 GND。
